description: Verify array containment and cardinality projection
setupSql:
CREATE TABLE products (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(50), tags TEXT[]);
INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 'Headphones', ARRAY['wireless', 'audio', 'sale']), (2, 'Cable', ARRAY['audio']), (3, 'Earbuds', ARRAY['wireless', 'audio']);
expectedOutputSql: SELECT id, name, tags, cardinality(tags) AS total_tags FROM products WHERE tags @> ARRAY['wireless', 'audio'] ORDER BY id;
